constructor.details: Initializes the StakingKPI contract with the Hub address for access control Only called once during deployment

params.hubAddress: Address of the Hub contract for access control and contract dependencies

getDelegatorReward(uint72,uint256,addres.details: Calculate the reward for a delegator in an epoch (correct only for the finalized epochs).

params.delegator: Delegator's address to calculate rewards for
params.epoch: Epoch number to calculate rewards for (must be finalized)
params.identityId: Node's identity ID that the delegator is delegating to

returns._0: Reward amount for the delegator in the specified epoch (V8 archive only)

getDelegatorStats(uint72,address).details: Returns the total stake of a node's delegator.

params.delegator: Delegator's address to get stake for
params.identityId: Node's identity ID to get total stake for

returns._0: Total stake of the node's delegator (V8 archive only)

getNetNodeRewards(uint72,uint256).details: Fetch the net rewards for all node's delegators in an epoch (rewards of node's delegators - operator fee) Calculates the total rewards available to node's delegators after operator fees are deducted Handles both cases: when operator fee has been claimed and when it hasn't

params.epoch: Epoch number to calculate net rewards for
params.identityId: Node's identity ID to get net rewards for

returns._0: Net rewards available for distribution to the node's delegators in the epoch

getNodeStats(uint72).details: Returns the total node stake (v4.0.0 — V10 canonical raw TRAC      sum from `ConvictionStakingStorage.nodeStakeV10`).

params.identityId: Node's identity ID to get total stake for

returns._0: Total stake of the node (V10 canonical, uint96-clamped)

getOperatorFeeStats(uint72).details: Returns the total node operator fee balance (v4.0.0 — read from      `ConvictionStakingStorage`; V8 SS balance is no longer written      by the V10 claim path).

params.identityId: Node's identity ID to get total operator fee balance for

getOperatorStats(uint72).details: Returns the total stake of all admin keys for a node.

params.identityId: Node's identity ID to get total stake for

returns._0: Total stake of all admin keys for the node (V8 archive only)

initialize().details: Initializes the contract by connecting to all required Hub storage dependencies Called once during deployment to set up contract references for staking calculations Only the Hub can call this function

name().details: Returns the name of this contract for identification purposes

version().details: Returns the version of this contract for compatibility tracking

convictionStakingStorage().notice: v4.0.0 — V10 canonical aggregates (node stake, operator-fee         balance, per-epoch reward flags). Source of truth for the         node-level KPI surface.

getDelegatorReward(uint72,uint256,addres.notice: DEPRECATED in V10 (v2.0.0): the inner `_simulatePrepareForStakeChange`         reads V8 stake base which is unmaintained for V10 nodes         (mandatory migration). Returns 0 for V10 delegators because         `stakeBase == 0` short-circuits the reward simulator. The         V10 reward path lives on `StakingV10._claim` (compound-into-raw,         per-NFT). A V10 tokenId-keyed reward KPI is deferred to a         follow-up PR.

getDelegatorStats(uint72,address).notice: DEPRECATED in V10 (v2.0.0): V8 stake base is per-(identity,address)         keyed, unmaintained for V10 nodes. Returns 0 for V10-only         delegators. V10 stake is per-tokenId (NFT-keyed); a V10         tokenId-keyed equivalent is deferred to a follow-up PR.

getOperatorStats(uint72).notice: DEPRECATED in V10 (v2.0.0): reads V8 stake base which is         unmaintained for V10 nodes (mandatory migration). Returns 0         for V10-only nodes. A V10 tokenId-keyed equivalent is deferred         to a follow-up PR.

stakingStorage().notice: V8 archive accessor. Retained ONLY for V8-stake-base-keyed         per-delegator KPI reads (`getOperatorStats`,         `getDelegatorStats`, `_simulatePrepareForStakeChange`).         These are accurate for V8 archive queries but return 0 for         V10 nodes (mandatory migration → V8 stake base unmaintained).         A V10 tokenId-keyed per-delegator KPI is deferred to a         follow-up PR.
